lua: CAM = require('lib.camera'); W = require('lib.world'); S = require('lib.state'); LOOK = function(lx, ly, lz, ty, fov, tx, tz) local v = nova.named('van'); local s, c = math.sin(v.heading), math.cos(v.heading); local g = W.height(v.x, v.z); local ax, _, az = v:to_world(tx or 0, 0, tz or 0); CAM.pinned = { v.x + s * lz + c * lx, g + ly, v.z + c * lz - s * lx, ax, g + (ty or 0.85), az, fov or 30 } end; local v = nova.named('van'); v:teleport(4.5, -132, 0); local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z = 9, -126

route.capture: back-34-closed: from behind, the doors shut, the roof without its slab
back-straight-closed: square from behind, both rear windows from outside
hold-inside-to-doors: from inside the hold at the cab wall, the rear windows from inside

route.lua: local s = nova.scene_now(); local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z = s:van_point({ 1.3, 0, -1.9 }); S.van_load = { 'hazel', 'pip' }

route.capture: back-open: the doors open, into the hold, its floor to the walls and the sill
back-open-high: the doors open, looking down onto the floor from behind and above
hold-from-above: from just under the roof (the roof is not drawn from inside), the whole floor
cab-from-above: the cab from just under its roof: the floor, the step plate, the front wells' housings

route.lua: S.van_load = {}; local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z = 9, -126

route.capture: cab-to-windscreen: from the seat, the windscreen's glass from inside
cab-to-side-window: the right side window's glass from inside
side-window-outside: the right side window from outside
doorway: the left doorway, the step plate and the front well's housing
side: the whole left side, the two tones and the roof's round edge
roof-behind: from behind and above, the roof with no slab
under: low beside the van, its underside closed
